event_text: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, stages a grand adventus in the city, and is met with popular jubilation. Maxentius' body is fished out of the Tiber and beheaded.
headline: Constantine the Great enters Rome after his victory at the Battle of the Milvian
story: Barry and Susan witnessed today's history, but the report went unwritten.
